findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "company_jobs" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Full LIST of open jobs at one company (up to 500), newest first, read live from its public Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, SmartRecruiters and Recruitee job board. Us…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp?via=mcp-registry" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: hiring_signals, company_jobs · Public sink: hiring_signals.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: hiring_signals, company_jobs · Public sink: hiring_signals

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
